routes.label: Pair the smallest and largest integers

question: The arithmetic mean (ordinary average) of the fifty-two successive positive integers beginning with \(2\) is:
solution:
Starting at \(2\), the fifty-second integer is \(2+51=53\). Pair the smallest with the largest, then continue inward:
\[
(2,53),\ (3,52),\ \ldots,\ (27,28).
\]
Each pair sums to \(55\): moving inward increases one entry by \(1\) and decreases the other by \(1\). These \(26\) pairs use all \(52\) integers exactly once. The arithmetic mean is the total divided by the number of integers, so
\[
\text{mean}=\frac{26\cdot55}{52}
=\frac{55}{2}=27\frac12.
\]
The answer is choice C.
